TerraGroup is one big box of mysteries. What could be crazier than turning a man into the living dead? I doubt Tarkov will survive this blow if we can't stand up to it. At Therapist's request, I did some research and found a working computer that might have some useful data left on it. But now we need you. Prepare the thumb drive exactly as instructed, get to TerraGroup's computer in their office in the city, and leave it there. You'll have to stay at the PC to make sure the connection is established. Once you've done your part, our mutual acquaintance and I will do the rest - all a matter of technique.}} ==Objectives== * Locate the required computer at TerraGroup's Cardinal office on [[Streets of Tarkov]] * Install the [[Flash drive with special software|flash drive]] at the computer to download the files ==Rewards== * +20,500 [[EXP]] * [[Mechanic]] Rep '''+0.02''' * 100,000 Roubles ** 105,000 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1 ** 115,000 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2 * 3× [[4.6x30mm FMJ SX ammo pack (40 pcs)]] * 3× [[HK MP7 4.6x30 40-round magazine]] * 3× [[HK MP7A2 4.6x30 submachine gun]] {{quote|Okay, I see the connection, so you did everything right... Oh, they're DDoS-proofed. But what if we access it from here, you assholes? Hm, that's where Mr. Kerman comes in. Are you still here? I'm sorry, I don't have time to chitchat anymore. Kerman just sent over his data, said he's not gonna let TerraGroup's projects ruin our city. While he takes down the security, I have to format the drives to give Therapist everything we can find out.}} ==Initial Equipment== Unlocks craft for [[Flash drive with special software]] at [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center level 1]]. ==Guide== {|class="wikitable" ! colspan="6" |Related Quest Items |- !Icon !Item name !Amount !Requirement !'''[[Found in raid|Find in raid]]''' !Notes |- |[[File:Secure Flash drive Icon.png|link=Secure Flash drive]] |[[Secure Flash drive]] |1 |Required !N/A |Crafting material. |- |[[File:Flash drive with special software icon.png|link=Flash drive with special software]] |[[Flash drive with special software]] |1 |Stashed item !N/A |Has to be crafted in the [[Hideout]] (Intelligence Center lv. 1). |} To complete this quest, you first need to craft a [[Flash drive with special software]] at the Intelligence Center level 1 in the [[Hideout]]. Afterwards you have to stash it near the screens in the surveillance room inside the TerraGroup security post building on [[Streets of Tarkov]]. Jump onto the desk and stand right in the corner of the room. The infected cannot climb and will struggle to path to you and hit you while on top of the desk. The flash drive can be stashed from this spot.
